title: Naming Alternatives and Relativizing Statements
summary: Comparing options, softening claims, and referring to alternatives.
whyItMatters: Sensitive personal and financial decisions require language that compares real alternatives and limits claims to the evidence available.

mentalModel.title: Option, criterion, consequence
mentalModel.content: Name each alternative, compare it against the same criteria, and state likely consequences.

mentalModel.title: Soften certainty, not clarity
mentalModel.content: Use cautious markers while still stating exactly what is known, assumed, or preferred.

ruleBlocks.title: Name genuine alternatives
ruleBlocks.content: Use entweder ... oder, eine andere Möglichkeit wäre, and statt dessen.

ruleBlocks.title: Compare on equal criteria
ruleBlocks.content: Evaluate cost, risk, effort, flexibility, and personal priorities for each option.

ruleBlocks.title: Relativize broad statements
ruleBlocks.content: Use in vielen Fällen, nicht unbedingt, soweit ich weiß, and das hängt davon ab.

ruleBlocks.title: Make a conditional recommendation
ruleBlocks.content: State which option fits under which circumstances.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Das gilt nicht in jedem Fall.

tables.title: Balanced Option Comparison
rows: Welche Option passt unter diesen Bedingungen?

sentenceStructure: Acknowledge a valid counterpoint before qualifying it.
Tie the recommendation to stated conditions.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies sensitive choices that need balanced criteria.
Past sequencing supports explanations of how later evidence changed an earlier decision.

examples.de: Einerseits ist das Konto kostenlos, andererseits bietet es weniger Service.
examples.en: On the one hand the account is free; on the other, it offers less service.

examples.de: Eine Versicherung ist nicht unbedingt sinnvoll, wenn das Risiko sehr klein ist.
examples.en: Insurance is not necessarily sensible when the risk is very small.

examples.de: Ob ein gemeinsames Konto passt, hängt davon ab, wie das Paar seine Finanzen organisiert.
examples.en: Whether a joint account fits depends on how the couple organizes finances.

examples.de: Soweit ich weiß, kann der Vertrag jährlich gekündigt werden.
examples.en: As far as I know, the contract can be cancelled annually.

examples.de: Wenn Flexibilität wichtig ist, wäre die zweite Option wahrscheinlich geeigneter.
examples.en: If flexibility is important, the second option would probably be more suitable.

commonMistakes.wrong: Name two options when one is clearly impossible.
commonMistakes.reason: A useful comparison requires genuine choices.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use so many hedges that the conclusion disappears.
commonMistakes.correct: Mark uncertainty and still state a conditional recommendation.
commonMistakes.reason: Caution should not make the message unusable.

commonMistakes.wrong: Compare one option by price and another by convenience.
commonMistakes.correct: Apply the same criteria to all options.
commonMistakes.reason: Parallel criteria make the comparison fair.

tips: Replace 'immer/nie' with a more accurate scope.
